title: Kaderblick Video Combiner – docs.kaderblick.de

hero.heading: Kaderblick Video Combiner
hero.lead: Kaderblick Video Combiner creates one football video from selected time ranges in several recordings. The cut list defines the source, starting point, duration, captions, audio and order of every segment.

body:
Official project documentation · GitHub project and installation guide

Understand the workspace

  • Add new segment: select a video, start time and duration. A title and subtitle are optional. Include audio keeps the original sound for that segment.
  • Plus and minus beside Video: add a source file or remove the selected source.
  • Time range: helps you define the beginning and end of the scene.
  • Segments: lists video, start, duration, title, subtitle, audio and status for every scene.
  • Up and Down: change the order in the finished video.
  • Edit: loads an existing entry so that you can correct it. Remove deletes the selected segment from the list; Clear list removes all segments.
  • Total duration: adds together the duration of all segments.
  • Logo: adds a club logo or removes it again.
  • Pipeline status and log: show progress, the current processing step and any error message.

Create a video

  1. 1
    Add the source recordings
    Use the plus beside Video and select all recordings required for the cut.
  2. 2
    Define the first segment
    Choose its source, enter the starting point and duration, and decide whether the segment should contain audio.
  3. 3
    Add captions if required
    Enter a title and subtitle only when they should be displayed in the finished video.
  4. 4
    Add the segment
    Select Add. Repeat these steps for every scene.
  5. 5
    Review the order
    Move entries with Up and Down. Check source, start, duration and the displayed total duration.
  6. 6
    Choose an optional logo
    Use Select in the logo area. Remove returns to an output without a logo.
  7. 7
    Build the video
    Select Create video and monitor the status and log until processing has finished.

Save and load a cut list

Save cut list stores the assembled segments. Load cut list opens a previous arrangement so that it can be checked, updated or built again. Use this when a longer editing task needs to be continued later.

Advanced options

  • Video: controls output quality, frame rate, resolution, sound, replacement of existing output and optional computer shutdown after completion.
  • YouTube: enables upload and accepts the video title, playlist, visibility and tags.
  • Clear cache: removes reusable intermediate results when a segment must be created again from the source.

Check YouTube visibility before uploading. Unlisted is accessible only with the link, Private only to permitted accounts, and Public to everyone.

Use the result

The finished video can be passed to Kaderblick Video Manager or added to the video section of a match.
